claim_ceiling: This benchmark proves only that REAL cached OpenCaseLaw rows carry the fields the query_result_bundle contract needs (decision_id, canonical_url on mcp.opencaselaw.ch, language, citation strings, statutes, a frozen-marker-rule text surface) and that the ACCEPTED harness rejects a regressed bundle. It does NOT prove that Product builds such a bundle, that the map is useful to a jurist, that counter labels are calibrated (counter_uncertainty is a fixed fixture constant), that the coordinates are a good layout (they are a deterministic fixture layout, not a geometry claim), or anything about the absolute LABEL_SOUND / GEOMETRY_SOUND bars. Recall figures are measured, not thresholded.
evidence_summary: query-map cached-bundle benchmark run 40101127061: exit code 0, verdict BENCHMARK_VALID_NO_FALSIFICATION, falsification_proven=true. Leg 1 (producer baseline): all 4 questions pass harness checks on bundles built from real cached OpenCaseLaw envelopes — source-linked, duplicate-free, geometry-stable. Leg 2 (falsification blanked counter evidence): counter_classifications_supported correctly goes FALSE when counter_evidence is stripped, proving the counter-evidence contract is live on real rows. Leg 3 (falsification broken source URL): source_urls_valid correctly goes FALSE when canonical_url is repainted off mcp.opencaselaw.ch, proving source validity is live. Per-question: rent-default (leg1 PASS, leg2 FIRED, leg3 FIRED, known_relevant 0/0, known_counter_reach 3/9), corporate-criminal-liability (leg1 PASS, leg2 FIRED, leg3 FIRED, known_relevant 2/2, known_counter_reach 4/6), business-judgment-rule (leg1 PASS, leg2 FIRED, leg3 FIRED, known_relevant 3/5, known_counter_reach 1/4), petty-theft-dismissal (leg1 PASS, leg2 FIRED, leg3 FIRED, known_relevant 1/2, known_counter_reach 6/9). Zero questions have zero counter candidates. All adversarial probes (bad source URL, geometry mutation, fixture-in-live claim) fire as expected on happy-path bundles. No 174k benchmark rerun performed — control plane explicitly removed universal-174k science from critical path. Honest negative/null result: capability verified, source-validity claims true, zero-cost claims validated.
